(4)

在教育方面，高度重视旨在进行彻底抵抗的精神训练。

4. 目前是否存在尚不清楚。

问：该机构是否有毕业生伪装成亲日人物，从而接近维新政府圈子？

答：我相信可能有这样的人，但没有我的熟人。

问：上海发生的各种恐怖暴行、纵火和其他暴力行为是否由你们的追随者所为？

答：由于我们没有横向联系，我对这些罪行一无所知。

问：关于本案你还有其它要陈述的吗？

答：恳请宽大处理。

(签名) 谭保义。

page_data.en:
Dan Pao Yee (譚保毅)

The above person made the following further
statement at the Japanese Gendarmerie Headquarters on
October 25, 1939.

Q. Are you sure that the number of the pistols brought
to the scene of assassination was four (4)? How is
it that Ping Foo Chang states that they were five (5)
instead of four (4)?

A. I remember they were four, but they might be five, I
wonder.

Q. When did you learn that the victim was Cheng Loh(陳籙)?
Your previous statement is vague on this point.

A. When all of us met at the Chang Chow Hotel at about
4 p.m. on that day, I asked Yue Ho Zing(岳河情)
whom we were going to kill. He replied it was Cheng
(  ), high official in Nanking. As I stated on the
previous questioning it was not until I saw the following
day's paper that I learned that our victim had been
Cheng Loh(陳籙), Minister of Foreign Affairs.

sd/ Dan Pao Yee.
page_data.zh:
谭保毅 (Dan Pao Yee)

上述人员于1939年10月25日在日本宪兵队总部作了如下进一步陈述。

问：你确定带到刺杀现场的手枪数量是四 (4) 支吗？为何平福昌声称是五 (5) 支而不是四 (4) 支？

答：我记得是四支，但也可能是五支，我不确定。

问：你何时得知受害者是陈箓 (Cheng Loh)？你之前的陈述在此点上含糊不清。

答：当天下午4点左右，当我们都在常州旅馆 (Chang Chow Hotel) 聚会时，我问岳河情 (Yue Ho Zing) 我们要杀谁。他回答说是南京的一位高官陈 ( )。正如我在上次审讯中所述，直到第二天看到报纸，我才知道我们的受害者是外交部长陈箓 (Cheng Loh)。

签名/ 谭保义。

page_data.en:
Dan Pau Zung ( 〔此处转录不清〕 ) , age 30, Chinese
Junking // 2nd Sub-Lieutenant K. todo
Japanese Gen.H.Q. 25.10.39

The above person made the following statement at
the Japanese Gendarmerie Headquarters on Oct. 25, 1939.
My name is Dan Pau Zung alias Dan Pao Ding, age
30, native of S-Kin Village, Sunkiang Hsien, Kiangsu,
corn-chandler, residing at No. 426 Route Frelupt, F.C.
I am an elder brother of Dan Pau Yee.
In order to make this case clear, I shall state
the movements of Dan Pau Yee.
Some time in March this year, when I was smoking
opium at Room 302, Cham Nam Hotel, Dan Pau Yee visited
on me there. In those days he looked nervous and when
I asked him to be open with me he confided that he together
with his conspirators had murdered Cheng Loh, Minister of
Foreign Affairs.
Since that time he failed to come to see me, and
I was anxious about him.
Towards the middle of June, he unexpectedly called
at me and stated that he, in accordance with instructions,
had come to Shanghai again.
After his return to Shanghai from Hongkong, he
introduced Ping Foo Chang to me as a school-mate. Later
in the previous evening of our arrest, 28.6.39, he again
introduced to me Ping Foo Chang as a school-mate. At
that time I did not know that Ping Foo Chang was a conspirator
of an assassination of Cheng Loh.
Whilst held in the custody of the S.M.Police I
asked Dan Pau Yee if Ping Foo Chang was also an assistant of
page_data.zh:
谭宝宗 (Dan Pau Zung) (〔此处转录不清〕)，30岁，中国人
 Junking // 二等少尉 K. todo
日本宪兵队总部 1939年10月25日

上述人员于1939年10月25日在日本宪兵队总部作了如下陈述。
我叫谭宝宗，别名谭宝鼎 (Dan Pao Ding)，30岁，籍贯江苏松江县新泾村 (S-Kin Village, Sunkiang Hsien, Kiangsu)，粮商，居住在法租界法拉普路 (Route Frelupt) 426号。
我是谭保义的兄长。
为了澄清此案，我将陈述谭保义的行踪。
今年3月的某个时候，当我在新南酒店 (Cham Nam Hotel) 302房吸食鸦片时，谭保义来那里看望我。那些日子他看起来很紧张，当我让他对我坦诚相告时，他透露他与同谋者一起谋杀了外交部长陈箓。
从那以后他没再来看我，我很为他担心。
6月中旬，他突然来访，称他奉命再次来到上海。
他从香港回到上海后，将平福昌作为同学介绍给我。后来在我们被捕的前一晚，即1939年6月28日，他再次将平福昌作为同学介绍给我。当时我不知道平福昌是刺杀陈箓的同谋。
在被工部局警务处 (S.M.Police) 拘留期间，我问谭保义，平福昌是否也是

page_data.en:
Cheng Leh, to which Dan Pau Yee replied in affirmative.
Ting Foo Chang has no such alias as Wong Yet Ping (王亞彬).
Question : According to your previous statement you were
informed by Dan Pau Yee, prior to his departure for Hongkong
that he (Dan Pau Yee) was responsible for the assassination
of Cheng Leh.
Was this not your mistake and was not the case
that you were informed of it after his return from Hongkong.
A. It was my mistake, it was told to me after his
return from Hongkong.
Q. Have you anything else to state regarding this case?
A. No.

sd: Dan Pau Yee.

陈勒 (Cheng Leh) 案的助手，谭保义给予了肯定的答复。
丁福昌 (Ting Foo Chang) 没有王亚彬 (Wong Yet Ping) 这个别名。
问：根据你之前的陈述，在谭保义前往香港之前，他告诉你他 (谭保义) 对刺杀陈勒 (Cheng Leh) 负责。
这难道不是你的错误吗？事实难道不是在他从香港回来后你才得知的吗？
答：这是我的错误，是在他从香港回来后告诉我的。
问：关于本案你还有其它要陈述的吗？
答：没有。

Ping Foo Cheng(        ) age 24, unemployed
(Kiangsu)
Fu Wing Prefecture,             x Sub-Lieutenant Katoda.
Jap. Gendarmerie    20-10-39

The abovementioned person made the following state-
ment at the Shanghai Gendarmerie Headquarters on 20-10-39.
My nationality, domicile, name and age are true as
mentioned previously, I told my name as Veng Yee Ping(        )
at the G.M.P., but this is untrue.
I was born in Shanghai, and when I was 13 years of
age I finished the whole course of Sih Nyuen(        ) Primary
School in Nantao. I entered Ching Shing(        ) Middle
School in Nantao at the age of 13 and changed to Eh Ching
(        ) Middle School in Kiangwan at the age of 15. I left
the above Middle School without completing the whole course
at the age of 18.
My family consists of my father, age 53, step-mother,
age known, my wife, age 19, and myself but all were unemployed.
My father possessed himself of a right of a glass-shop valued
approx. $1.0000.00 in Nantao and my family has been earning a
livelihood depending upon the profit of the shop. My family
had no more property valuable. My religion is Buddhism.
In connection with political operations and assassina-
tion of the late Chin Loh, the former minister of foreign
affairs of the Reformed Government I will state now. As
abovementioned, I left the Eh Ching(        ) Middle School at
the age of 18 without completing the whole course and I helped
the glass-shop which was my family profession, in Nantao.
I proceeded to Hankow at the age of 20, and I obtained employ-
ment at Hupei Provincial Police Bureau stationed in Hankow as
a detective at the age of 21.

平福成 (Ping Foo Cheng)(        )，24岁，无业
(江苏)
抚翼府 (Fu Wing Prefecture),             x 小野田 (Katoda) 少尉。
日本宪兵队    1939年10月20日

上述人员于1939年10月20日在上海宪兵队总部作了如下陈述。
我的国籍、住所、姓名和年龄如前所述属实，我在工部局警务处 (G.M.P.) 自称名为 Veng Yee Ping(        )，但这不属实。
我出生在上海，13岁时完成了南市四元 (Sih Nyuen)(        ) 小学的全部课程。13岁时我进入南市敬胜 (Ching Shing)(        ) 中学，15岁时转至江湾的 Eh Ching (        ) 中学。18岁时，我在未完成全部课程的情况下离开了上述中学。
我的家庭成员包括父亲（53岁）、继母（年龄不详）、妻子（19岁）和我自己，但均无业。我父亲在南市拥有一家玻璃店的权益，价值约10,000.00美元，我家一直依靠该店的利润维持生计。我家没有其他贵重财产。我的宗教是佛教。
关于政治活动及刺杀维新政府前外交部长陈洛 (Chin Loh) 一事，我现在陈述如下。如上所述，我18岁时未完成全部课程便离开了 Eh Ching (        ) 中学，并在南市帮助经营家族职业的玻璃店。
20岁时我前往汉口，21岁时受雇于驻汉口的湖北省警察局，担任侦探。

page_data.en:
- . 2 -
The detective of the Police Bureau was the ostensible
name, and , in fact, I was employee of Yong Shing Garden Cinema
Studio attached to the 2nd Section of the Central Statistics
Bureau of Central Military Affairs Committee, and I engaged
in supervision and enquiries into the movements and thoughts
of actors under the command of Tai Lie( ).
During June, 1937, I was detailed to Shanghai by the
above Studio for the purpose of approaching one prominent
Chinese named Tsu Ch Van( ) and for study of my profession
Soon after this, Sino-Japanese Hostilities broke out and
Tsu Ch Van was appointed as commander of the Independent Unit
of Kiangsu and Chikiang Military Active Committee, i.e.
resisting-Japan plain clothes Unit. I joined the Unit as a
candidate. I came from Hankow to Shanghai alone and had no
company.
In February, last year(1938), by the order of Li Zan
Shang( ), i/c of the Personnel Bureau attached to the
3rd Section of the Military Committee I went to Ling Loo( )
in Hunan Province via Hankow and entered the Special Training
Depot attached to the Military Committee. I received Military
training at the Depot for three months. The training was
divided into three sections, i.e. military, action and intel-
ligence and I joined the military section.
After the training completed, I intended to enter
the military University at Changsha( ), but the University
sustained heavy damage by the bombing of the Japanese planes,
and accordingly the University was forced to close up.
page_data.zh:
- . 2 -
警察局侦探只是名义上的职务，事实上，我是中央军事委员会中央统计局第二处附属的永胜花园电影院制片厂 (Yong Shing Garden Cinema Studio) 的员工，在戴烈 (Tai Lie)( ) 的指挥下，从事对演员的行动和思想的监视及调查工作。
1937年6月，上述制片厂派遣我到上海，目的是接触一位名叫 Tsu Ch Van( ) 的著名中国人，并进修我的专业。
不久后，中日敌对行动爆发，Tsu Ch Van 被任命为江浙军事行动委员会独立支队司令，即抗日便衣队。我以候补队员身份加入该队。我独自从汉口来到上海，没有同伴。
去年（1938年）2月，奉军事委员会第三处附属人事局局长李赞尚 (Li Zan Shang)( ) 之命，我经汉口前往湖南的 Ling Loo( )，进入附属于军事委员会的特别训练所。我在该所接受了三个月的军事训练。训练分为三个部分，即军事、行动和情报，我加入了军事部分。
训练结束后，我打算进入长沙 (Changsha)( ) 的军事大学，但该大学因日军飞机轰炸遭受严重破坏，因此被迫关闭。

page_data.en:
- 3 -

I again came to Shanghai by order of Li Fan Bai
(        ), accompanied by Chiang Su(        ), Shou Tsung
(        ), and Ling Ta Zung(        ), via Hongkong, on 10-10-
1938. I later interviewed one named Wang, substitute of
Teng Dah Mo(        ) who was the head of Shanghai Branch of
the Military Committee, and I received the order to engage
in assassination activities as few people have been engaging
into assassination activities at present in Shanghai, with
pay of $48.00 per person.

The Shanghai Branch of the Military Committee, under
the command of Teng Dah Mo was divided into two sections, i.e.
Guerrilla and assassination.

In connection with the assassination of Chin Loh,
the former minister of foreign affairs of the Reformed
Government, I state what I know.

At about 6 or 7 p.m. on 19-8-39(Jan. 1st. Lunar year)
I and my followers visited Ching Loh's residence on Yu Yuen
Rd. and assassinated him.

The names of assassins who participated in the
assassination of Ching Loh were as follows:-

1. Yee Woo Ching(        ) director of the party, armed with
pistol
2. Zee Kueh Gee (        ) member, armed with pistol
3. Yeu Ping San (        ) "    "    "    "
4. Yeu San Yuen (        ) "
5. Dan Pau Kyi (        ) "
6. Ping Fah Chang (        ) " armed with pistol, myself.
7. Liou Hai San (        ) " armed with pistol
8. Lieu        (        ) "
page_data.zh:
- 3 -

我奉李凡白（音译）之命，于1938年10月10日，由蒋苏（音译）、寿宗（音译）和凌达宗（音译）陪同，经香港再次来到上海。后来我会见了一位姓王的人，他是军事委员会上海分会负责人滕达摩（音译）的代理人，我接到命令从事暗杀活动，因为目前在上海从事暗杀活动的人很少，每人的报酬为48.00元。

在滕达摩指挥下的军事委员会上海分会分为两个部门，即游击部和暗杀部。

关于维新政府前外交部长陈箓被暗杀一事，我陈述我所知道的情况。

1939年8月19日（农历正月初一）下午6点或7点左右，我和我的随从前往愚园路陈箓的住所并将其暗杀。

参与暗杀陈箓的刺客名单如下：-

1. 余武清（音译），组长，配备手枪
2. 纪桂芝（音译），组员，配备手枪
3. 尤平三（音译），"    "    "    "
4. 尤三元（音译），"
5. 单保基（音译），"
6. 张炳发（音译），" 配备手枪，即本人。
7. 刘海三（音译），" 配备手枪
8. 刘（音译）（音译），"

page_data.en:
- 4 -

As abovementioned 8 Chinese took part in the assassination of Mr. Ching Loh which was planned by the 1st. named.

The 1st, 2nd, and 3rd named entered the residence of Mr. Ching Loh, fired their respective pistol, while 4th, 5th and 8th named kept watch outside the premises during the assassination was carried out.

I entered the premises armed with pistol but I did not fired my pistol. At about 8 p.m. 17-2-39(30-12-38 of Lunar calender) I interviewed Yue Hoo Ching at Birlington Hotel (I forget the room number) on Nanking Road., when Yah( ) told me that Ching Loh, the Foreign minister of Reformed Government, would come to Shanghai, tomorrow, requesting me to assemble in the Hotel early in the morning following. On Jan. 1st.(Lunar calender) I then visited Yue Hoo Ching at the Birlington Hotel who requested me to go to Lieu's house off Rue Legrene ( ) F.C. to fetch pistols. I then proceeded to Lieu's house by a motor-car and brought 5 pistols concealing same in a wooden box.

The above Lieu was a member of the Military Affairs Committee.

At about 3 or 4 p.m. same date, abovementioned 8 persons met together at the Birlington Hotel and were informed that Ching Loh arrived at Shanghai from Nanking to-day, and assassination of the latter would be carried out within today. As abovementioned, 5 persons out of 8 armed with pistol proceeded to Yu Yuen Road.
page_data.zh:
- 4 -

如上所述，这8名中国人参与了由第一名所列者策划的陈箓先生暗杀案。

第一、二、三名进入陈箓先生住所，各自开枪射击，而第四、五、八名在暗杀执行期间在屋外放哨。

我携带手枪进入屋内，但我没有开枪。1939年2月17日（农历1938年12月30日）晚上8点左右，我在南京路的伯灵顿酒店（房间号我忘了）会见了余武清，当时叶（音译）告诉我，维新政府外交部长陈箓明天将抵达上海，要求我次日清晨在酒店集合。农历正月初一，我随后前往伯灵顿酒店拜访余武清，他要求我去法租界雷米路（音译）刘的住处取手枪。于是我乘汽车前往刘的住处，取了5支手枪，将其藏在一个木箱里带回。

上述刘某是军事委员会的成员。

同日下午3点或4点左右，上述8人在伯灵顿酒店聚会，并被告知陈箓今日已从南京抵达上海，将在今天内对其实施暗杀。如上所述，8人中有5人携带手枪前往愚园路。

在成功暗杀陈箓后，我将手枪丢弃在愚园路668弄入口附近，并乘公共汽车前往闸北（音译）的一家小旅馆（我忘了旅馆的名字）。我住在那家旅馆里。第二天，第二名所列者纪桂芝（音译）来到我居住的旅馆，并住了三天。第三名所列者尤平三暂时在杨树浦（音译）包士角（音译）的龙庚（音译）饭店落脚。当时其他成员的下落完全不知。大约十天后，我和尤平三、纪桂芝一起，与尤三元、余武清、刘海三以及刘一同乘坐“德兴”轮（S.S. Tak Hing）前往香港。**〔此处转录不清〕** 抵达香港后 **〔此处转录不清〕** 大约十多天后，所有参

page_data.en:
- 6 -

ticipated in the assassination of Ching Loh were invited at
a dinner party held under the auspices of Tsi Lee. At that
time I saw Tsi Lee for first time., and he was an influential
person among the Military Committee, he always staying in
Hongkong. I do not know his address in Hongkong.

Particulars of Tsi Lee were about 5'4" in height, me-
dium built, age about 37/8, native of Chikiang and speaks
mandarin.

About June 1st. this year, I together with Dan Pau
Nyi; You Ping San, and Tan San Yuen, arrived at Shanghai ( I
forget the name of the steamer) and registered at Asia Hotel
on Avenue Edward 7th. On 8-6-1930, I and Dan Pau Nyi removed
to No.18 Ya Foo Lodging House on Avenue Joffre while two
**〔此处转录不清〕**
on the early morning of 29-6-30 I together with Dan Pau Nyi
and Dan Pau Tang, elder brother of Dan Pau Nyi were arrested by
the police.

I became acquainted with Dan Pau Tang who visited his
brother at Ya Foo Lodging House twice previously.

Dan Pau Tang had no connection with the assassination
of Ching Loh nor with the Military Committee.

As my statement dates back to previous date, about
4 or 5 days before my arrival at Shanghai on 1-6-30, one
named **〔此处转录不清〕** , relative of Tsi Lee, age about 40,
Chikiang, stout build, about 5'5" in height, and his subordi-
nate officer named Wong Loo Chao( ) came to Shanghai as
page_data.zh:
- 6 -

加暗杀陈箓的成员都被邀请参加由季李（音译）主办的晚宴。那时我第一次见到季李，他是军事委员会中有影响力的人物，一直住在香港。我不知道他在香港的地址。

季李的体貌特征约为身高5英尺4英寸，中等身材，年龄约37/8岁（原文如此），浙江人，讲普通话。

今年6月1日左右，我和单保尼（音译）、尤平三以及谭三元（音译）一起抵达上海（我忘了轮船的名字），并登记入住爱多亚路（Avenue Edward 7th）的亚洲酒店。1930年6月8日，我和单保尼搬至霞飞路（Avenue Joffre）亚福旅馆18号，而另外两名 **〔此处转录不清〕** 1930年6月29日清晨，我和单保尼以及单保尼的哥哥单保堂（音译）被警察逮捕。

我是通过之前两次去亚福旅馆探望他哥哥而认识单保堂的。

单保堂与陈箓暗杀案或军事委员会没有任何关联。

A. I have been in communication with Wang Loo Chao, but

I continued my statement. Although I forgot
the exact date, assassination of Tsung Zoong Ming (          )
was carried out in Hanoi (          ), French Indo-China, this
year. This assassination was done by our party under the
command of Tai Lih (          ), member of the Military Committee
and Yue Loh Sing (          ) was the leader of the party
and Wong Loo Jee (          ) was the direct leader of the
assassination.

I was informed of this by Wong Loo Jee whilst I
stayed in Hongkong about April this year. At that time
the assassins attacked the sitting-room of Wang Ching Wei on
1st. floor of the residence, however, Wang was not in the
room and Tsung Zoong Ming was in the room, and Tsung was
killed instead of Wang Ching Wei.

I do not know it.

上述人员于1939年10月21日在上海日本宪兵队总部作出以下陈述。

我继续我的陈述。虽然我忘记了确切的日期，但今年在法属印度支那的河内（音译）实施了针对曾仲鸣（音译）的暗杀。这次暗杀是由我们的小组执行的，受军事委员会成员戴立（音译）指挥，余洛生（音译）是该小组的组长，王鲁吉（音译）是暗杀行动的直接领导人。

今年4月左右，当我住在香港时，王鲁吉告诉了我这件事。当时刺客袭击了汪精卫住所一楼的客厅，然而汪不在房间里，曾仲鸣在房间里，结果曾代替汪精卫被杀。

问题（由调查官员提出）。
你认识刺客余柏生（音译）、杨伟武（音译）和宋亚腾（音译）的名字吗？

回答：
我不知道。

问题：讲述你们组织的体系和结构。

王鲁吉（音译）（头目）

to Hongkong Wong Loo Jao took the place of Yue Woo Ching.
I was told that Mao Van Li and Wong Loo Jao are still in
Shanghai. I do not know whether the leaders of the party
were in communication with Chungking Government Organs or
Guerrillas in Shanghai.

The abovementioned person made the following state-
ment at the Japanese Gendarmerie Headquarters in Shanghai on

Question by the investigating officer:

State the situations of activities of the organ under
the command of Tui Lee(    ) in Shanghai prior to your
arrest?

A. As me ntioned previously, I knew Tan Fun Kyi, Yau Ping
Fan, Tan San Yuen, who came to Shanghai together with me on
1-8-39 from Hongkong, and Kuo Wan Li, Wong Lee Chee. When
I encountered a member of the party I exchanged salutes
mutually or I posed to be stranger to him. About 300 members
attached to the organ of Tui Li were despatched to Shanghai.

Q. How was the procedure of communication between the
Military Committee and the various Organ?

A. I heard that they had a secret wireless apparatus in
the Settlement and they kept in touch with Chungking, Chung-
king, Tientsin and Hongkong.

Q. Lian Hai San(    ) was a former commander of a guard
of Chang Ch Liang(    ), and there was a staff of Yu
Yu Tseong(    ) among the guard of the late Ching Loh,
Yu Yu Tseong being a subordinate of Chang Ch Liang. and the
wife of Ching?(    ), son of Ching Loh, was the sister of
Chang Ch Liang, therefore, you had connection with Lian
Hai San with these implicated connections?

A. I became acquainted with Lian Hai San at Astorhouse
Hotel.(    ) prior to the assassination, and I did not

Ping Fah Chong（    ）

日本宪兵队    1939年10月24日。

上述人员于1939年10月24日在上海日本宪兵队总部作出如下陈述。

调查官提问：

陈述在你被捕之前，受 Tui Lee（    ）指挥的机关在上海的活动情况？

答：如前所述，我认识 Tan Fun Kyi、Yau Ping Fan、Tan San Yuen，他们与我于1939年8月1日从香港一同来到上海，还有 Kuo Wan Li、Wong Lee Chee。当我遇到该党成员时，我们互相致意，或者我装作与他不认识。约有300名隶属于 Tui Li 机关的成员被派往上海。

问：军事委员会与各组织之间的联络程序是怎样的？

答：我听说他们在租界内设有秘密无线电台，并与重庆、重庆、天津和香港保持联系。

问：Lian Hai San（    ）曾是 Chang Ch Liang（    ）的一名卫队指挥官，而在已故 Jing Loh 的卫队中有一名 Yu Yu Tseong（    ）的职员，Yu Yu Tseong 是 Chang Ch Liang 的下属。Jing（    ）的妻子，即 Jing Loh 的儿子，是 Chang Ch Liang 的妹妹，因此，你通过这些牵连关系与 Lian Hai San 有联系吗？

答：我在刺杀发生前在 Astorhouse Hotel（    ）结识了 Lian Hai San，我并不

page_data.en:
- 2 -

know the connections told by you.

Q. Is Dan Pau Zung a member of your party?

A. He had no connection with us, and he is elder brother of
Dan Pau Hyi. I first saw him at Tseng Nan Hotel( )
where he was smoking opium, and I, through introduction of
Dan Pau Hyi knew him. I do not know whether he knew cases
committed by us.

Q. How is the procedure to mop up the members of the Military
Committee existing in Shanghai?

A. There is no way except buying off them, and first bribe
the low class members, then you will able to arrest the high
class members by their information. I do not know the places
where they harbour themselves.

Q. How was the connection with Guerrilla?

A. I do not know.

Q. Are many members of the Committee joined in the Reformed
Government under pretext of pro-Japanese extensively?

A. I think it possible, but I do not know it at details.

Q. Where was the address of Yah Hoo Ching( ) prior
to the assassination of Ching Loh?

A. I do not know it as he always come to my place for
communication. At the time of assassination of Ching Loh
our members assembled at Burlington Hotel as mentioned previous-
ly.

Q. When did you know the arrival of Ching Loh at Shanghai
from Nanking?

A. On the previous day(30-12-1939 of Lunar calendar) You
page_data.zh:
- 2 -

知道你所说的这些关系。

问：Dan Pau Zung 是你们党派的一员吗？

答：他与我们没有联系，他是 Dan Pau Hyi 的哥哥。我第一次在 Tseng Nan Hotel（    ）见到他，当时他正在吸食鸦片，我是通过 Dan Pau Hyi 的介绍认识他的。我不知道他是否知道我们所犯的案件。

问：清理存在于上海的军事委员会成员的程序是怎样的？

答：除了收买他们之外别无他法，先收买下层成员，然后你就能通过他们提供的信息逮捕上层成员。我不知道他们藏身之处。

问：与游击队的联系如何？

答：我不知道。

问：委员会的许多成员是否以亲日为借口大量加入了维新政府？

答：我认为有可能，但我不知道细节。

问：在刺杀 Jing Loh 之前，Yah Hoo Ching（    ）的地址在哪里？

答：我不知道，因为他总是来我的住处进行联络。在刺杀 Jing Loh 时，我们的成员如前所述在 Burlington Hotel 集合。

问：你何时得知 Jing Loh 从南京抵达上海？

答：在前一天（农历1939年12月30日）You

page_data.en:
- 3 -

Hee Ching called upon me at Tang Chong Hotel(          )stat-
ing that "You shall have urgent business to-morrow".  Zee
Mao Geo(          ) and Yuh Ping San who were with in the room
were also informed of this.  At that time I realised that
assassination would be carried out, I did not know who was
the person to be assassinated.  At about 1 p.m. 1st-30(Lunar
calender), You Hee Ching came to Tang Cheng Hotel and in-
structed me that I should go to see Lieu residing French
Concession and fetch pistols to Burlington Hotel.  I then
went to Lieu's house, obtaining pistols, and I visited
Burlinton Hotel.  Lieu was "Lieu Hai San.  One other Lieu
was a member of our party and later he went to Soochow for
some operation.  It was about 2 p.m. same date when I arrived
at Burlinton Hotel with pistols, after this one Chinese
whom I did not know came to the hotel and conversed with
You Hee Ching.  Shortly after this other 7 or 8 members
assembled there.  You Hee Ching did say nothing when departed
the hotel for the assassination.  I went to Yu Yuan Road
accompanied by Lieu Hai San and Yue Ping San.  I realised that
the person whom we assassinated on the previous day was
Ching Loh when I read the news papers.

Q.  Was there any connection between your organ and followers
of Ching Loh?

A.  I do not know it.  Nobody told me about it as they kept
everything secret.

Q.  How is your mental state at present?

A.  "Resist Japan" and "Protect Chang Kah She" had gone to
page_data.zh:
- 3 -

Hee Ching 在 Tang Chong Hotel（          ）拜访了我，称“你明天有紧急事务”。同在房间里的 Zee Mao Geo（          ）和 Yuh Ping San 也得知了这一消息。当时我意识到将执行刺杀行动，但我不知道要被刺杀的人是谁。大约在（农历）1月30日下午1点，You Hee Ching 来到 Tang Cheng Hotel，指示我去法租界见 Lieu 并取手枪到 Burlington Hotel。于是我去了 Lieu 家，取得手枪后，我前往 Burlinton Hotel。Lieu 是“Lieu Hai San”。另一位 Lieu 是我们党派的一员，后来他去苏州进行某种行动。大约在同日下午2点，我带着手枪到达 Burlinton Hotel，此后一名我不认识的中国人来到酒店并与 You Hee Ching 交谈。不久之后，另外七八名成员在那里集合。You Hee Ching 离开酒店去执行刺杀时什么也没说。我在 Lieu Hai San 和 Yue Ping San 的陪同下前往愚园路。当我读到报纸新闻时，我才意识到我们前一天刺杀的人是 Jing Loh。

问：你的组织与 Jing Loh 的追随者之间有任何联系吗？

答：我不知道。没人告诉我这些事，因为他们对所有事情都保密。

问：你目前的精神状态如何？

答：“抗日”和“拥护蒋介石”已成为

- 4 -
the past. I want to repudiate my past activities. I beg to
you to dispose of me leniently.
The above statement is true.

Ping Foo Chang

The above person made the following further statement
at the Japanese Gendarmerie Headquarters on October, 26, 1939.
Question. Is it true that in preparation to the murder
of Cheng Loh you removed five pistols from the home
of a certain Lieu in the French Concession to the
Burlintong Hotel at about 1 p.m. on the day of the
assassination of Cheng Loh, Minister for Foreign
Affairs ?
And did your party take five pistols to the
scene of crime ?
Answer. I am sure that they were five, it is vivid in
my memory. There is no mistake about it, for I
removed them in person. I opened the box at the
home of Lieu and found one pistol of Japanese make
and four browning pistols in it. The number of
ammunition was sixteen rounds for browning (four
rounds for each browning) and some fifteen rounds
for that of Japanese make. It was one of these
browning that I took with me to the scene of crime.
Question. In the first statement you mentioned that at
about 8 p.m. on the previous day of the assassination
you had been informed by Tse Ho Ching that Cheng Loh
would come from Nanking without fail on the follow-
ing day. While in the third statement you stated
that you had been informed by Tse Ho Ching at the
time mentioned above that you would have a business
on the following day. Which is the truth ?
page_data.zh:
Ping Foo Chang

上述人员于1939年10月26日在日本宪兵队总部作出如下进一步陈述。
问：为准备谋杀外交部长 Cheng Loh，你是否在 Cheng Loh 遇刺当天约下午1点，将五支手枪从法租界某位 Lieu 的家中移至 Burlintong Hotel？
并且你们党派是否将五支手枪带到了犯罪现场？
答：我确定是五支，这在我记忆中很清晰。这一点没错，因为是我亲自移送的。我在 Lieu 家中打开箱子，发现里面有一支日本造手枪和四支勃朗宁手枪。弹药数量是勃朗宁手枪十六发（每支勃朗宁四发），日本造手枪约十五发。我带到犯罪现场的是其中一支勃朗宁手枪。
问：在第一次供述中，你提到在刺杀前一晚约8点，Tse Ho Ching 通知你 Cheng Loh 次日必定从南京来。而在第三次供述中，你 stated 在上述时间 Tse Ho Ching 通知你次日有事务要办。哪一个是事实？

page_data.en:
ANSWER.
My third statement was the truth.
QUESTION.
New statement regarding the instructions of
Yue Ho Ching which you stated to have been given
prior to your departure from the Marlinteng Hotel,
is incoherent. What is the truth ?
ANSWER.
Yue Ho Ching said nothing special. He merely
said, "You do not know the locality, so you go with
Lieu Hai San". I do not know anything else.

Sd. Ding Foo Chang.
page_data.zh:
答。
我的第三次供述是事实。
问。
关于你在离开 Marlinteng Hotel 之前收到的 Yue Ho Ching 的指令的新陈述，前后不一。事实是什么？
答。
Yue Ho Ching 没说什么特别的话。他只是说，“你不熟悉地点，所以你跟 Lieu Hai San 一起去”。其他的一概不知。

签署：Ding Foo Chang。

Ref. Shan-Ken Ko No. 1115.
Shanghai Detachment,
Japanese Gendarmerie
October 6, 1939.

Major K.M.Bourne,
Commissioner of Police,
S.M.P./S.M.C.

Sir,

I have to point out that owing to the fact
that the evidence produced by the Japanese Gendarmerie
Headquarters against Dan Pau Yee (譚保毅) and Ping Poh
Chang (平福昌) alias Weng Yee Ping (王延彬) was
considered by the S.M. Police as vague, we have not been
given the custody of the arrested two men.

As it can be recalled that these two men had
been arrested with your assistance at Ya Foo (霞飛)
Lodging House, Rue Paul Beau, French Concession, on June
29, 1939.

However, an additional evidence against the
two accused which were seized at No. 17 Rue Tenant de La
Tour, F.C., during the raid carried out by the Japanese
Consular Police with the assistance of the S.M. Police
on July 15, 1939, are now submitted herewith.

As it can be seen from the report addressed to
one Ling (凌) these two accused are responsible for the
assassination of Mr. Cheng Loh (陳籙), former Minister of
Foreign Affairs of the Reformed Government.

In view of the newly submitted evidence as per
attached report, I have the pleasure to request you that
Dan Pau Yee and Weng Yee Ping alias Ping Poh Chang be
handed over to us at your earliest convenience.
I am, Sir,
Yours faithfully,
Chopped : Major-General S.Miura
Officer-in-Command

K.M. Bourne 少校，

上海公共租界工部局警务处/上海公共租界工部局。

先生：

兹指出，由于日本宪兵队总部针对谭保毅（Dan Pau Yee）及平福昌（Ping Poh Chang，又名王延彬 Weng Yee Ping）所提供的证据被上海公共租界警方认为含糊不清，我方未能接管这两名被捕男子。

回想起来，这两人曾于1939年6月29日，在法租界保罗·博路（Rue Paul Beau，即霞飞路）的亚富旅馆（Ya Foo Lodging House），在贵方的协助下被捕。

然而，现随函附上针对这两名被告的补充证据，该等证据系1939年7月15日日本领事警察在上海公共租界警方的协助下，对法租界唐恩德劳路（Rue Tenant de La Tour）17号进行突击搜查时缴获。

从致一名凌姓人士（Ling）的报告可见，这两名被告应对维新政府前外交部长陈籙（Cheng Loh）遇刺案负责。

鉴于附件报告中提交的新证据，本人荣幸地请求阁下尽早将谭保毅及王延彬（又名平福昌）移交我方。

此致，
敬礼

文件清单如下：
(1) 来自金谷（K. Kanaya，音译）上校的第 Shankanke 813 号函，转交日本宪兵队声称牵涉第一被告谭保毅（又名 Dan Pau Nyi）和第三被告王延平（Wong Yee Ping，又名平福昌 Ping Foh Chang）的文件。
(2) 致 Pau Nyi 的信函，由 Zung Zau Tsung（音译）签署，日期为1939年4月14日。
(3) 致 Pau Nyi 的信函，由 Ho Wei Ming（音译）签署，日期为1939年4月27日。
(4) 致 Pau Nyi 的信函，由 Zung Zau Tsung（音译）签署，日期为1939年4月29日。
(5) 致 Pau Nyi 的信函，由 Pau Zeh Su（音译）签署，日期为1939年5月18日。
(6) “清”字第2004号命令，由方斋（Fong Chay，音译）司令〔此处转录不清〕于1939年7月签发予平福昌（第三被告），指示对 Wong Ching Wei（音译）及 Tseu

page_data.en:
4/2

Veh Hai, and reported on.
Translations of all the above documents are
attached.
D.P.S. Yamahara was instructed to ascertain from
Sgt. Major Katoda, how these documents came into
possession of the Gendarmerie, but up to the present
no reply has been received.
The 1st. accused Dan Pau Yee alias Pau Hyi admits
that documents 2 to 5 are his property and states that
to the best of his knowledge these letters were amongst
his effects at the Ya Fee Lodging House. This however,
cannot be correct, as the search at time of arrest was
conducted by the S.M.P. and French Police and no such
documents found.
Documents 2 to 5, whilst showing that the 1st.
accused is friendly with persons who are actively employed
with the Nationalist Government Forces, do not prove
that he personally, has been so actively employed.
There are certain passages in these letters however,
which tend to show that the original statement made by
the 1st. accused is not the whole truth. The points in
question follow:-
1. In document No.2 the writer asks:-
"have you been sent there (Hongkong) by the
Training Unit under the Military Affairs Commis-
page_data.zh:
4/2

Veh Hai（音译）的活动进行调查并提交报告。
上述所有文件的译文附后。
已指示副警务总监山原（Yamahara）向警佐长加藤（Katoda）查明这些文件是如何落入宪兵队手中的，但截至目前尚未收到回复。
第一被告谭保毅（又名 Pau Hyi）承认文件2至5为其所有，并称据其所知，这些信件是其在亚菲旅馆（Ya Fee Lodging House）的个人物品中的一部分。然而，这不可能正确，因为逮捕时的搜查是由上海公共租界警方和法国警察进行的，并未发现此类文件。
文件2至5虽然显示第一被告与积极受雇于国民政府军队的人员关系友好，但并不能证明他本人也如此受雇。然而，这些信件中的某些段落倾向于表明，第一被告最初的陈述并非全部属实。相关问题点如下：
1. 在文件第2号中，写信人问道：
“你是否被军事委员会训练处派往那里（香港）——

page_data.en:
4/3

When questioned the 1st. accused stated he has never
had any connection with such a unit.

2. In document No.3, the writer states:-
    "yet you may return in the near future to the
    deserted province of the South-west"

The 1st. accused denies having been anywhere outside
of Shanghai except the one visit to Hongkong from March
to May, 1939.

3. In document No.5, the writer states:-
    (a) "A reply was received from him stating you
        had gone to Shanghai via Chekiang."

When questioned the 1st. accused stated he returned
to Shanghai from Hongkong by a Jardine Matheson Ship
which only stopped at Swatow.

    (b) "Subsequently I received a reply from Ts Ming,
        saying that you had been in Shanghai for two
        months and then gone to Hongkong."

This would imply that the 1st. accused was only in
Shanghai two months before he left for Hongkong, yet
he maintains that he never left Shanghai from the
commencement of hostilities until he went to Hongkong
in March 1939. The person referred to as Ts Ming, is
the cousin of the 1st. accused, who supplied him with
money, so should have known his whereabouts.

Regarding document No.6, which is an order to
Ping Foh Chang (the alias of the 3rd. accused) to make
enquiries regarding the activities of Wong Ching Wei etc.
page_data.zh:
4/3

受讯时，第一被告称他从未与该单位有任何联系。

2. 在文件第3号中，写信人称：
    “不过你不久后可能会回到荒凉的西南省份”

第一被告否认除1939年3月至5月访问香港外，曾去过上海以外的任何地方。

3. 在文件第5号中，写信人称：
    (a) “收到他的回信，称你经浙江去了上海。”

受讯时，第一被告称他从香港乘怡和洋行轮船返回上海，该船仅在汕头停靠。

    (b) “随后我收到 Ts Ming（音译）的回信，说你在上海待了两个月，然后去了香港。”

这意味着第一被告在前往香港前仅在上海待了两个月，但他坚称从战事开始直到1939年3月去香港之前，他从未离开过上海。信中提到的 Ts Ming 是第一被告的表亲，曾为他提供资金，因此应该知道他的行踪。

关于文件第6号，这是一份命令平福昌（第三被告的化名）调查 Wong Ching Wei 等人活动的命令。

page_data.en:
4/4

When letter Shanghai 607 was received and mentioned
the alias (Ping Foh Chang) of the 3rd. accused, he was
questioned regarding same and admitted that he was
also known by this name. On being confronted with
Document No.6 he states that he has never seen this
document before and also denies that he is known by
the alias of Ping Foh Chang. The 1st. accused also
states he has never seen this document before.

MSS
7/7/39.

C. B. Lypole
D.S.I.
page_data.zh:
4/4

当收到提及第三被告化名（平福昌）的第 Shanghai 607 号信函时，他就此事接受了讯问，并承认他也以此名字为人所知。当出示文件第6号时，他声称以前从未见过此文件，并否认他以平福昌这一化名为人所知。第一被告也声称以前从未见过此文件。

MSS
1939年7月7日。

C. B. Lypole
助理总监

page_data.en:
April 14th.

Dear Pao Nyi,

I have received your letter dated 26th. ultimo, and noted
that you have arrived in Hongkong. Will you please let me
know the recent situation of my native place and Shanghai.
I would also **〔此处转录不清〕** if you would let me know if you
have gone to Hongkong on any errand, or to seek for a
position in the business circle, or if you have been sent
there by the Training Unit under the Military Affairs Commission.

Liang Wei has been appointed as a supervisor to Dong Bang,
Annam to build a godown. Dah Ming is in Yunnan University.
Ping Yee and Loong Faung remain in Kwenming, the former is
working in the Land Dept. of the Zoe Kweng Railway Line, and the
latter has a job in the Kwenming Architect's Office. Foh Hai
and Wei Ming are still in Zang and Ts. Sam Pah joins the Telegram
Corps under the Military Affairs Commission in Hwei-ling. Goo
Hou joins the Military Training Corps in **〔此处转录不清〕** and I have
no news from the others. I still remain in Tso-chow.

Hung-yang was bombing by the Japanese planes and received
great damage. The military authorities are going to quit the
Zang-ts, and I will proceed to Wei-teng to earn a living. I
am not afraid that I will starve.

Awaiting your reply.

Signed: Sang Lou Huang
page_data.zh:
4月14日。

亲爱的 Pao Nyi：

我已收到你上月26日的来信，并知悉你已抵达香港。能否请你告知我家乡和上海的近况？我也希望**〔此处转录不清〕**你能告诉我，你去香港是办事，还是在商界谋职，亦或是被军事委员会训练处派往那里。

梁伟（Liang Wei，音译）已被任命为安南（Annam）东邦（Dong Bang，音译）仓库建设的监工。大明（Dah Ming，音译）在云南大学。平义（Ping Yee，音译）和龙芳（Loong Faung，音译）留在昆明，前者在浙赣铁路线的土地部门工作，后者在昆明建筑师事务所任职。福海（Foh Hai，音译）和伟明（Wei Ming，音译）仍在张茨（Zang and Ts，音译）。三宝（Sam Pah，音译）加入了惠陵（Hwei-ling，音译）军事委员会下的电报团。古厚（Goo Hou，音译）加入了**〔此处转录不清〕**的军事训练团，其他人我没有消息。我仍留在曹州（Tso-chow，音译）。

红阳（Hung-yang，音译）遭到日本飞机轰炸，受损严重。军方当局打算撤离张茨（Zang-ts，音译），我将前往威腾（Wei-teng，音译）谋生。我不担心会挨饿。

等候你的回信。

签名：桑楼黄（Sang Lou Huang，音译）

page_data.en:
TRANSLATION OF A LETTER ADDRESSED TO PAU NYI
FROM MO WEI MING.

Elder Brother Pau Nyi,

The fate of a man is, like a puzzle, not
predicable, but frequent change is always better.

Although you are now living in the enchanting
port of Hongkong, yet you may return in the near future
to the deserted province of the south-west. What there
is a good life. When you recollect the circumstances
whilst you were in Zee Ka Pang, I feel myself dull.
I imagine that happy feeling can only be obtained in
favorable work.

Every day I am reading books and chattering
with others, for I have but only a little labour to
do here.

Hiam Ta, where the home of Poh Hai is located,
and which is about 30 kilometers away from Tsuchow,
is busy in removing away the rails. According to the
latest rumours the Japanese troops are retreating
towards Wuchang and Hankow. Therefore there is every
possibility that the route will be extended to Changsha
again.

Lian Den has been transferred to Ben San ( a place
in Annam) due to the transportation business of the
Kweiling and Tsung Nan Huan Highway motor trucks.
The detailed address of the above will be submitted to
you after same is properly ascertained.

Den is now working in the Communication Dept.
of the Liang Kiang Political Bureau, Kweiling. Any
letter can be addressed to Box No. 51 Liang Kiang.
He might be transferred to some other place
when you wrote to him last time.

Poh Ming is studying at the Yunnan University.
Leong Wan is employed in a certain construction company
page_data.zh:
致 PAU NYI 的信函译文，来自 MO WEI MING。

Pau Nyi 兄：

人的命运如同谜题，不可预测，但频繁变动总是更好。

虽然你现在生活在迷人的港口香港，但你不久后可能会回到荒凉的西南省份。那里生活美好。当你回忆起在徐家汇（Zee Ka Pang）时的情形，我感到自己有些迟钝。我想那种愉快的感觉只能在顺利的工作中获得。

我每天读书并与他人闲聊，因为我在这里的工作很少。

海姆塔（Hiam Ta，音译），即泊海（Poh Hai，音译）的家乡所在地，距离徐州（Tsuchow）约30公里，正忙于拆除铁轨。根据最新谣言，日军正向武昌和汉口撤退。因此，路线很有可能再次延伸至长沙。

连登（Lian Den，音译）因桂林和宗南环（Tsung Nan Huan，音译）公路卡车的运输业务，已被调往本三（Ben San，安南某地）。上述详细地址在妥善核实后将提交给你。

登（Den）现在在桂林两江政治局的通讯部工作。任何信件均可寄至两江51号信箱。上次你给他写信时，他可能已被调往其他地方。

泊明（Poh Ming，音译）在云南大学学习。龙万（Leong Wan，音译）受雇于某建筑公司

page_data.en:
- 2 -

in Kweiming, to whom any letter may be sent c/o
Deh Ming. ~~Pau-Yee-is~~

Ping yee is employed in surveying on Su Kwan
Railway, (letter to him may also be sent c/o Deh Ming).
The rails on Shiang - Tsung Railway are being removed,
and I do not know if Eying Feh and Feo Deu are still
in the rail-removing unit or has gone to Kweiyang.

The situation has developed as what is said
of the future world. The Japanese troops have reached
the extremity of their attack, and are on their way to
collapse. On the contrary the rehabilitation in the
interior is getting more hopeful day by day. Our duty
is more important as each day passes. Determination
should be strengthened.

As Hongkong is the centre of the notables and
defeated persons, please let me know if the criticism
there coincides with that in the interior.

From : Mo Wei Ming.
Date : April 27th.
page_data.zh:
- 2 -

在昆明，任何信件可通过德明（Deh Ming，音译）转交给他。 ~~Pau-Yee-is~~

平义（Ping yee，音译）受雇于苏赣铁路（Su Kwan Railway，音译）的测量工作，（给他的信也可通过德明转交）。湘总铁路（Shiang - Tsung Railway，音译）的铁轨正在拆除，我不知道 Eying Feh（音译）和 Feo Deu（音译）是否仍在拆轨队，还是已去了贵阳。

局势的发展正如人们对未来世界所说的那样。日军的进攻已达极限，正走向崩溃。相反，内地的复兴日益充满希望。随着每一天的过去，我们的责任更加重要。决心应得到加强。

由于香港是名流和败退人员的中心，请告诉我那里的批评是否与内地一致。

来自：Mo Wei Ming。
日期：4月27日。

page_data.en:
April 29th.

Dear Pao Nyi,

I wrote to you sometimes ago, and your letter dated April
10th. I have received and duly noted. I would like to know
if you are going to Hongkong on any errand and your daily life
at present. Hongkong is a safe place especially during the
national crisis.

Liang Wei has been appointed as a supervisor to Ansan to
build a godown. Kya Zang and Poh Hai have joined the Labour's
Unit for removing rails at Hen-yang. Wei Ming remains in Ta-chow,
if the measure of removing rails progresses, we may meet each
other in the near future. Loong Vung, Ping Yee and Dah Ming
are all in Kwenming. Will you come to interior through Kwanning.

The final battle will be carried out in the West of Chekiang
Provinces, and the rails of Hankow and Canton Railway line are
going to be removed. The work of Hankow and Canton Railway line
had been completed about two years and it is a pity that the
rails of the whole line will be removed. I will remain here
(the Hankow & Canton Railway line) until all the rails are
removed. I will not stay at a place all the time as I did past
year.

It is very easy to obtain a position because the new railway
lines are going to be built in the South-west and North-west
provinces. You may come to the interior if you would like to
obtain a job.

I shall be glad to know the latest news of my native place
and Shanghai. Please write to me when you arrive in Hongkong.

Signed : Zung Sau Tsung
page_data.zh:
4月29日。

亲爱的 Pao Nyi：

我前些时候给你写过信，我已收到并 duly noted 你4月10日的来信。我想知道你去香港是否为了办事，以及你目前的日常生活。香港是一个安全的地方，尤其是在国家危机期间。

梁伟（Liang Wei，音译）已被任命为安三（Ansan，音译）仓库建设的监工。嘉张（Kya Zang，音译）和泊海（Poh Hai，音译）加入了衡阳（Hen-yang）的拆轨劳工队。伟明（Wei Ming，音译）留在达州（Ta-chow，音译），如果拆轨措施进展顺利，我们可能在不久的将来见面。龙云（Loong Vung，音译）、平义（Ping Yee，音译）和大明（Dah Ming，音译）都在昆明。你会经过广宁（Kwanning，音译）来内地吗？

最后的战役将在浙江省西部进行，粤汉铁路线（Hankow and Canton Railway line）的铁轨将被拆除。粤汉铁路线的工作大约在两年前完成，可惜整条线路的铁轨都将被拆除。我将留在这里（粤汉铁路线），直到所有铁轨都被拆除。我不会像去年那样一直待在一个地方。

由于西南和西北省份将要修建新的铁路线，很容易找到工作。如果你想找工作，可以来内地。

我很高兴得知我家乡和上海的最新消息。抵达香港后请给我写信。

签名：Zung Sau Tsung（音译）

page_data.en:
TRANSLATION OF A LETTER SENT TO
PAO NYI FROM TSU CH U.

Dear Cousin Pao Nyi,

Having not seen you for several months
I am thinking of you very much.

Before retreat of Chinese troops from Nanking
and Hankow I sent you two letters which were addressed
to Hankow, and these letters were both returned to me
due to the fact that they could not be delivered.
Since then I could not ascertain your whereabouts.

It suddenly came into my mind that Mr. Wen,
living in Hanyang, being an intimate friend of yours,
might know your movements. I then, sometime in February
this year, sent a letter to Mr. Wen. A reply was later
received from him, stating that you had gone to Shanghai
via Chekiang, but it was not mentioned whether or not
you had arrived at Shanghai, in view of which I was
still unable to obtain any proper information re your
whereabouts.

Last month when sending letters to my family
and my cousin Ts Ming I asked both to inform me in
their replies if you had been in Shanghai. Subsequently
I received an answer from Ts Ming, saying that you had
been in Shanghai for two months and then went to
Hongkong. I am happy to learn the above information
and, if you please, will be more glad to know what sort
of employment you have now in Hongkong as well as your
recent health. Did you go home when you were in Shanghai?
Are your parents well? Besides, kindly let me know where
your elder brother is and how he is doing.

On 3rd and 4th inst. Hsia Tso Ying Ka, where I
had made my abode previously, was bombed and ruined.
It was lucky enough that I had removed from Hsia Tso
Ying Ka two months ago to Shaung Ching somewhere I am
page_data.zh:
致鲍毅（Pao Nyi）之信函译文，发信人为祖佐苏（Tsu Ch U）。

亲爱的表弟鲍毅：

数月未见，甚为挂念。

在中国军队从南京和汉口撤退之前，我曾给你寄去两封信，地址均写的是汉口，但因无法投递，这两封信都被退回给我。自那以后，我便无法查明你的下落。

我突然想到，住在汉阳的文先生（Mr. Wen）是你的密友，或许知道你的行踪。于是，今年二月间，我给他去了一封信。后来收到他的回信，称你已取道浙江前往上海，但信中并未提及你是否已抵达上海，因此我仍无法获得关于你下落的准确信息。

上月，我在给家人和我的表弟慈明（Ts Ming）写信时，请他们在回信中告知我你是否在上海。随后我收到慈明的回信，说你在上海待了两个月后去了香港。得知上述消息我很高兴，如果你方便的话，我更想知道你现在在香港从事何种工作，以及你近期的健康状况如何。你在上海期间回家了吗？令尊令堂安好吗？此外，请告知我令兄身在何处，近况如何。

本月3日和4日，我之前居住的霞左营家（Hsia Tso Ying Ka，音译）遭到轰炸并被毁。幸运的是，我已于两个月前从霞左营家搬至双庆（Shaung Ching，音译）某处，即我现在居住的地方，从而避开了此次事件。

page_data.en:
- 2 -

now living, and thereby escaped from the incident.
Loh Chain after staying and working in Hupeh
for three months, was instructed by me to come to
Szechwan where he remained for about 2 months and
is now employed in the Yunnan- Burma Highway Company.
On route to Kunming he met robbers and was robbed of
his personal effects. No hurt was inflicted to him,
however.

Address : Tsu Zoh Su, 113 Shang Ching St Ka,
Chungking.

Address of Loh Chain : Workshop Dept. Yunnan-Burma
Highway Coy., 47 Hunan Rd.,
Kunming.

N.B. Please keep me informed if you change your address.

From : Cousin Tsu Zoh Su.
Date : May 18th.
page_data.zh:
- 2 -

罗链（Loh Chain）在湖北停留并工作了三个月后，奉我之命来到四川，在那里待了约两个月，目前受雇于滇缅公路公司。他在前往昆明的途中遭遇劫匪，随身财物被抢。不过，他本人未受伤。

地址：重庆上清寺街卡113号，祖佐苏（Tsu Zoh Su）收。

罗链（Loh Chain）地址：昆明湖南路47号，滇缅公路公司车间部。

注意：如变更地址，请告知我。

发信人：表弟祖佐苏（Tsu Zoh Su）。
日期：5月18日。

page_data.en:
Translation of a written order, Character "Tsing", No.
2034 is issued to one Ping Peh Chong by Fong Chay, commander
in chief of the "San Ming Chu Nyi Youth Corps, under the
National Youth Salvation Army Headquarters", dated 7th.
June, 1939.

It is hereby instructed that Wong Ching Wei,
a rebel of the Nationalist Government, and his accomplices
Tseu Voh Hai etc. are in Shanghai to organize a bogus
organ. Their activities are to be investigated immediately
and report all particulars pending further instructions.

Chopped: Fong Chay
Commander in chief of the
San Ming Chu Nyi Youth Corps
under the National Youth
Salvation Army Headquarters.

三名被告的指纹显示，他们均无前科记录。
已对三名被告全部录出口供。这些口供均无任何认罪内容。副本附后。这些口供已得到核实，福履理路（Route Frulupt）436号东顺祥米店（Dong Zung Ziang Rice Shop，音译）店主证实第二被告受雇于此；同时也核实了第三被告的父亲居住在海宁路1085号，该处入口位于余姚路宋庆龄路（Soong Ching Lee，此处原文可能有误，通常宋庆龄路不在余姚路，但依原文翻译）旁。
特别处已查阅缴获的文件，并附有这些文件内容的简要译文，其中似乎没有任何认罪内容。

1. Letter dated May 8, addressed to "School Mate Pao Yi(保毅)"
from Wen Ping(文萍 ), dealing with the writer's failure
in the examination for employment with the Post Office.

2. Letter dated May 18 from Wen Ping to Pao Yi about difficulties
in finding suitable employment for the maintenance of her
livelihood.

3. Letter dated May 27 from Wen Ping to Pao Yi advising the
latter to remain in Hongkong and not to come to Shanghai
and to continue his studies for his own future and expressing
regret for having addressed him the previous letter about
her difficult plight.

4. Letter dated June 9 from Wen Ping to Pao Yi asking him if
he has time to accompany her to the Strand Theatre to
see a dramatic performance on Sunday afternoon.

5. Letter dated June 15 from Wen Ping to Pao Yi about her
intention to practise swimming, etc. during the summer
vacation.

6. Letter dated June 22 from Wen Ping to Pao Yi telling him
that she will call on him at about 7 p.m. the following
day or the day after.

6a. Letter (incomplete and undated) addressed to Pao Yi apparently
from Wen Ping expressing her views about the effects of
social influence upon young people.

7. Letter dated June 4 addressed to Pao Yi by his brother Chung
(仲 ) asking for a further loan of several ten dollars.

8. Brief note (undated) addressed to Kwei Ching (夔俊 ) by one
Hsing (兴 ); asking the former to come to Shanghai for an
interview.

9. A passbook issued to Room 18, Joffre Boarding House by the

suits cleaned.

10. A receipt issued by the Dah Kuang Ming Dry Cleaning and
Dyeing Co. (大光明洗染衣料商店) on June 23, 1933 for two articles
for cleaning.

11. Two exercise books containing exercises in penmanship.

118! Accused

Sungkiang // D.S.I Accused

Sungkiang // D.S.I. ryde
C.1 30.6.39 Clerk Hsu

My name is Dan Mau Yee, age 25, native of Sungkiang
and I am at present living in Room 14 of the Ya Fee Lodging
House, 66 Rue Paul Beau, since 7.6.39.

I was born in Ta Ching Tsung near Sungkiang where
my father is a farmer. From the age of 8 years to 14 years
I was educated at my native place. From the age of 14 years
to 17 years I attended the Sungkiang Middle School. From
17 years to 20 years I attended the Tsung Hwa Business School
at Loh Ka rang, Nantso where I graduated in the year 1937.
After leaving school I stayed with my elder brother named
Dan Mau Tung (also arrested) in the Ts Co Faung, Rue Lafayette
for one week and then went home to my native place. I returned
to Shanghai during July 1937, about one month before the
hostilities started and again stayed with my brother who had
then moved to Wo Pung Foong, Rue Lafayette. About one month
later I went to live with my cousin named Tsou Ts Ming at San
Koh Ka, Nantao. About one week later hostilities broke out
and I lived in various lodging houses and with friends in the
International Settlement and French Concession until the end of
1938. During this period I did not do any work. I was given
money by my elder brother and sometimes I received money from
my father. At the end of 1938 I went to live with my cousin
Tsou Ts Ming, who had opened a rice shop at 486 Route Prolupt.
I stayed at this address until about March 10th 1939 when I
went to Hongkong and studied mechanics in the "Milton" Univer-
sity, Kowloon. I returned to Shanghai on about May 20th and
lived in Ya Tsen Lodging House Avenue Edward VII. My elder
page_data.zh:
118! 被告

松江 // 副督察长 被告

松江 // 副督察长 普赖德
C.1 1939年6月30日 书记员 徐

我叫丹茂义（Dan Mau Yee，音译），25岁，松江人，目前自1939年6月7日起居住在蒲石路66号雅菲旅馆14号房间。

我出生在松江附近的大清宗（Ta Ching Tsung，音译），父亲是农民。8岁至14岁我在家乡接受教育。14岁至17岁我就读于松江中学。17岁至20岁我就读于南桥罗家港（Loh Ka rang, Nantso）的中华商业学校，并于1937年毕业。毕业后，我和名叫丹茂通（Dan Mau Tung，亦被捕）的哥哥在拉斐特路茨草坊（Ts Co Faung，音译）住了一周，然后回到家乡。1937年7月，即在战事开始前约一个月，我回到上海，再次与当时已搬至拉斐特路武鹏坊（Wo Pung Foong，音译）的哥哥同住。约一个月后，我去南市三哥家（San Koh Ka，音译）与表弟邹慈明（Tsou Ts Ming，音译）同住。约一周后战事爆发，我在公共租界和法租界的各种旅馆和朋友家居住，直到1938年底。在此期间，我没有做任何工作。生活费由哥哥提供，有时也从父亲那里收到钱。1938年底，我去与表弟邹慈明同住，他在普罗普特路（Route Prolupt，即福履理路）486号开了一家米店。我在此地址住到1939年3月10日左右，随后前往香港，在九龙“米尔顿”大学（"Milton" University，音译）学习机械。我于5月20日左右返回上海，住在爱多亚路雅珍旅馆（Ya Tsen Lodging House，音译）。我的长兄

page_data.en:
- 2 -

brother and my cousin continued to give me money to support
myself.

On June 7th 1938, I moved to Room 14 of the Ya Foo
Lodging House where I was arrested on the morning of 20.6.39.

I have never been a soldier or had any connections with
any armed unit or organisation belonging to either the Nation-
alist Government or the Reformed Government of China and I
have no idea why I have been arrested.

Signed: Dan Fan Yee.
page_data.zh:
- 2 -

和表弟继续给我钱以维持生活。

1938年6月7日（注：原文如此，结合上下文可能是1939年之误，但依原文翻译），我搬入雅富旅馆14号房间，并于1939年6月20日上午在那里被捕。

我从未当过兵，也与属于国民政府或中国维新政府的任何武装部队或组织没有任何联系，我不知道自己为何被捕。

签名：丹范义（Dan Fan Yee，音译，与前文名字略有不同，依原文）。

page_data.en:
2nd accused

譚保成
/ D. J. I. Pryde
Clerk Hsu.

Jungkiang
C.1.    30.6.39

My name is Dan Pau Zung, age 33, native of Jungkiang.
I am employed a broker in the Dong Sung Siang (同順祥)
Rice Shop, at 426 Rte. Prolupt, which is owned by my cousin
named Tseu Ta Ming (周子敏). I earn over $100.00 per
month by commission.

I was born in Ts Ching (四泾) Tsung near Jungkiang
where my father is a farmer land-owner. I was educated
from the age of 6 years to 15 years in my native place.
From the age of 15 years to 19 years I attended the Sung-
Kiang Middle School. On leaving school I stayed in my
native place until the age of 25 years when I came to Shanghai
and studied law in the Fah Tsung (法政) Law School, Rte Pere
Robert for three years. After leaving this school I obtained
a position as labour supervisor at the "Sataon" Electric
Fan Factory, 999 Point Road and remained in this position
until the outbreak of hostilities when I was forced to
leave this employment. At that time I was living at No.
2 Ho Fung Foong (和丰坊), Rue Lafayette. My wife became
sick and on Sept. 15th 1937 I took my wife to my native
place and stayed there for one week and then returned to
Shanghai. I then looked for work and about 2 months later
obtained work in my cousin's rice shop at 426 Rte. Prolupt
and have remained working there ever since. I have never
been a soldier neither have I ever had any connections with
agents of the Nationalist Government or the Reformed Govern-
ment of China.

I went to Room 14 of the Ya Foo Lodging House at 10 p.m.
page_data.zh:
第二被告

譚保成
/ D. J. I. 普赖德
书记员 徐。

镇江
C.1.    1939年6月30日

我叫丹保宗（Dan Pau Zung，音译，中文名写作谭保成），33岁，镇江人。我在普罗普特路（即福履理路）426号东顺祥（Dong Sung Siang）米店担任经纪人，该店由我的表弟周子敏（Tseu Ta Ming）拥有。我每月佣金收入超过100美元。

我出生在镇江附近的四泾宗（Ts Ching Tsung，音译），父亲是地主兼农民。6岁至15岁我在家乡接受教育。15岁至19岁我就读于松江中学。毕业后，我在家乡待到25岁，随后来到上海，在贝勒路（Rte Pere Robert）的法政学校学习了三年法律。离开该校后，我在庞德路（Point Road）999号的“萨通”（Sataon，音译）电扇厂担任劳工监工，一直任职到战事爆发，被迫离职。当时我住在拉斐特路和丰坊2号。妻子生病，1937年9月15日我带妻子回到家乡，住了一周后返回上海。随后我寻找工作，约两个月后在我表弟位于普罗普特路426号的米店找到工作，并一直工作至今。我从未当过兵，也从未与国民政府或中国维新政府的代理人有任何联系。

1939年6月28日晚上10点，我去雅富旅馆14号房间

page_data.en:
- 2 -

on 28.6.39 for the purpose of visiting my younger brother
in reply to a request from him for money. I had no money
at the time but intended getting some from my cousin. My
cousin and I have assisted in supporting my younger brother
ever since he left school.I remained in the lodging house
for the night and was arrested in the morning.
I have no idea why I was arrested.
Since I returned from Sungkiang after leaving my
sick wife there I have never left the French Concession and
International Settlement.

Signed: Dah Pau Zung
page_data.zh:
- 2 -

目的是探望我的弟弟，回应他索要金钱的请求。当时我没有钱，但打算从表弟那里弄些钱。自从弟弟离校后，我和表弟一直协助供养他。我在旅馆过夜，并在早上被捕。
我不知道自己为何被捕。
自从将生病的妻子留在松江并返回后，我从未离开过法租界和公共租界。

签名：达保宗（Dah Pau Zung，音译，与前文名字略有不同，依原文）

page_data.en:
3rd Accused

NG YEE PING (王延彬)
Puning // D.S.I. Pryde
c.l 30.6.39 Clerk Hsu

My name is Ng Yee Ping, age 24, native of Puning.
I was born on Han Tsong Road, Chapai, my father, Wong Chi
Lai (王芝利), is a optician at Soong Ching Li, Tsepoo Road.
From the age of 7 to 13 I attended the San Kyih
Primary School, Kong Ying Ka, Nantao. From 13 years to
16 years I attended Yoh Ching Middle School, Kiangsun.
I then went home to Chapai and assisted my father in his
opticians business. My father's shop was situated on Tse
Zai Road, Nantao at that time. When hostilities broke out
I moved together with my family to Soong Ching Li, Tsepoo
Road, where we still carry on an optician's business.

On 9.6.39 I was in the French Park for recreation and
there met Dam Yan Yee (1st accused). I am an old friend of
Dam, as we were previously members of the same athletic club
in Nantao. We discussed various matters and decided that
we should both join some school and resume studies. On
the invitation of Dam, I went to live with him at Room 14
of the Ya Foo Lodging House, 65 Rue Paul Beau. I then
went home and got my personal effects and went to live in the
Ya Foo Lodging House. Apart from having been a member of
the Nantao Volunteers five years ago, I have never been a
soldier or in any way connected with the Nationalist Govern-
ment or the Reformed Government of China and I have never
been outside the International Settlement and French Concession
since the commencement of hostilities.

Signed: Ng Yee Ping.
page_data.zh:
第三名被告

王延彬 (NG YEE PING)
籍贯：普宁 // 副督察长 Pryde
c.l 1939年6月30日 书记员 Hsu

我叫王延彬，24岁，普宁人。
我出生于闸北汉宗路，父亲王芝利 (Wong Chi Lai)，是乍浦路宋庆里的一名眼镜商。
7岁至13岁时，我就读于南市孔家花园的三益小学。13岁至16岁时，我就读于江苏的育英中学。
随后我回到闸北家中，协助父亲经营眼镜生意。当时父亲的店铺位于南市子宰路。战事爆发后，我与家人一同搬至乍浦路宋庆里，我们至今仍在那里经营眼镜生意。

1939年6月9日，我在法租界公园游玩时遇到了谭保毅（第一被告，Dam Yan Yee）。我是谭的老朋友，因为我们以前都是南市同一家体育俱乐部的成员。我们讨论了各种事项，并决定一起进入某所学校继续学业。应谭的邀请，我搬去与他同住，地址是贝当路65号雅福旅馆14号房间。随后我回家取回个人物品，便搬入雅福旅馆居住。除了五年前曾是南市义勇队成员外，我从未当过兵，也从未以任何方式与国民政府或中华民国维新政府有过关联，而且自战事开始以来，我从未离开过公共租界和法租界。

签名：王延彬。

C.l. Misc. 99/39    Crime Branch
                    June 29,      39.
1

ASSISTANCE TO JAPANESE GENDARMERIE

At 5 a.m. on 29-6-39 Sgt. Major Kateda,
accompanied by another member of the Japanese
Gendarmerie, came to C.B.H.Q. and requested assistance
to visit Room 14 of the Ya Foo (霞飛) Lodging House,
66 Rue Paul Besn, French Concession, to arrest two
male Chinese, one of whom was named Ping Foo Chang
(平福昌), the other name unknown, on a charge of
being members of an Assassination Corps, active in the
Shanghai Area. Sgt. Major Kateda stated that according
to his information these two men had been concerned in
the assassination of Chen Loh (陳), Foreign
Minister of the Reformed Government and one of them
was believed to be armed. Sgt. Major Kateda also
stated that Room 14 of the Ya Foo Lodging House was
registered in the name of Dan Pan Yoo (譚保毅).

Assistance was rendered by D.S.I.s Pryde
and Lien Ching Ching, D.S. Rossington, D.P.S.s Yamahara
and Shimidzu, C.D.S. S and C.D.C. 296 and proceeded
to Lokawei Station where assistance was given by Chief
Inspector Delorme of the French Police and the stated
address visited.

The following persons were found in this
room and placed under arrest:-

2/6

201b
1-63076

侦探主任（特别分部
9c3

总部
C.l. Misc. 99/39    罪案组
                    1939年6月29日
1

协助日本宪兵队

1939年6月29日上午5时，警曹长 Kateda 在另一名日本宪兵队员的陪同下，来到罪案组总部，请求协助前往法租界贝当路66号雅福（霞飛）旅馆14号房间，逮捕两名中国男子，其中一人名为平福昌 (Ping Foo Chang)，另一人姓名不详，指控其为活跃于上海地区的暗杀团成员。Kateda 警曹长称，据其情报，这两人参与了维新政府外交部长陈箓 (Chen Loh) 的暗杀案，且相信其中一人持有武器。Kateda 警曹长还称，雅福旅馆14号房间是以谭保毅 (Dan Pan Yoo) 的名义登记的。

副督察长 Pryde 和 Lien Ching Ching、侦探长 Rossington、副巡官 Yamahara 和 Shimidzu、刑事侦缉股 S 以及刑事侦缉车 296 号提供了协助，并前往卢家湾警局，在那里得到了法国警察总督察 Delorme 的协助，随后前往上述地址。

在该房间内发现以下人员并将其逮捕：-

2/6

201b
1-63076

page_data.en:
2/B

(1) Dan Pau Yee (譚保毅 ), 45, Chinkiang,
S/Student, Room 14 Yah Foo Lodging House,
66 Rue Paul Doum.

(2) Dan Pau Ling(譚保成 ), 38, Chinkiang,
M/Rice Shop Assistant, 426 Route Prolupt
(brother of 1st. accused).

(3) Wong Yee Ping (王延彬 ), 34, Puning,
M/Spectacle-maker, Seung Ching Li, Tsapoo
Road.

The following documents were seized in the
room:-

24 photographs,
12 letters,
6 other documents.

The three arrested men together with the
seized documents were removed to Lalouvet Station
where they were detained by the French Police for
preliminary enquiries. The three men together with
the documents were handed over to the S.M.P. by the
French Police for enquiries at 5 p.m. 29.6.39 on
condition that they be returned to the French Police
for disposal if they are not charged by the S.M.Police.
Statements are being taken from the three
accused and the seized documents are being translated,
the result of which will form the subject of a further
report.

Geo. B. Ryde
D.S.I.
